note: Two signed sections of the Peggy's Hill trailhead parking lot, a T-shaped gravel lot about 25 m off Old Forge Road: 'Campsites will be delineated with signs in the parking area. Please use only your defined section.' The lot is in full sun and close enough to the road for traffic noise. It is the trailhead for the forest's equestrian trails, so campers share it with day-use parking and horse trailers; each site has a hitching post and a stone fire ring. Old Forge Road is paved to the entrance. One of the four Michaux areas kept open through the winter camping season (third Sunday after Thanksgiving to April 1); forest roads get no winter maintenance. No toilet; pack out trash. --Claude

DCNR names Peggy's Hill as an equestrian trailhead ('Teaberry Parking Area and Peggy's Hill Parking Area provide access to these trails'), not as an ATV access: the ATV page names only Big Flat and Piney Mountain. The Michaux snowmobile page names no trailheads at all, so snowmobile use of this lot is unknown.
